correctness.rationale: The minimal fiber data are IV at zero, eight I1 at the distinct nonzero discriminant roots, and good reduction in the infinity chart. The degree-one Weierstrass bundle gives a rational elliptic surface; Shioda–Tate gives rank 6 and the height formula gives 2+2(S·O) minus at most 2/3. The minimum 4/3 is attained and requires both disjointness from O and a nonidentity component at zero. In the blow-up chart X=tu, Y=tv, the equation is v²=4+tu³+4t³u; a polynomial point with linear Y coefficient ±2 meets one of the two nonidentity branches there. Disjointness from O gives the global degree bounds, so all and only minimum points have the stated polynomial ansatz up to inversion. Independent lexicographic elimination on the four coefficients of Y²−X³−4t⁴X−4t² (variable order e,d,a,b) gives b(B⁸−4096)(B¹⁶+34816B⁸+1048576) with B=b. For b≠0, division and substitution a=τb⁴ gives (32τ−1)(256τ²+32τ−1)=0; the three roots have nonzero denominator 384τ²−48τ+1 and give exactly the three stated nonzero W values and eight distinct b each. The b=0 case gives a(a²+4)=0. Distinct signs are distinguished by the linear Y coefficient. All b occur as coefficients; ratios of roots of B⁸−4096 give ζ₈. The coefficient field is exactly the splitting field, which over Q(ζ₈) is generated by eighth roots of elements of Q(√2), giving a 2-group both relatively and over Q.
residual_risks: The scope is geometric in characteristic zero with the stated Shioda height normalization; the audit does not compute the exact Galois group order, arithmetic rank, or specialization behavior.
